findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this unconditional return now grants access where the previous implementation denied it. Because the exported function no longer enforces tenant isolation, callers can authorize cross-tenant document reads.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body:
Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant. Requests where userTenant differs from documentTenant were previously denied, so this introduces a direct cross-tenant authorization bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
